import numpy as np, wave, os
SR=8363

rng=np.random.default_rng(12345)

def write(name, x):
    x=np.asarray(x,dtype=np.float64)
    x=np.clip(x,-1,1)
    y=(x*32767).astype('<i2')
    with wave.open('/workspace/src/samples/'+name+'.wav','wb') as w:
        w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR); w.writeframes(y.tobytes())

def saw(phase):
    return 2*((phase/(2*np.pi))%1)-1

def pulse(phase, duty=.34):
    return np.where(((phase/(2*np.pi))%1)<duty,1.,-1.)

# Bright square lead with a tiny detuned edge, short enough for rapid tracker phrasing
N=4096; t=np.arange(N)/SR
f=1.0
ph=2*np.pi*f*np.arange(N)/N
lead=(0.68*pulse(ph,.43)+0.20*saw(ph*2+0.13)+0.12*np.sin(ph*3.01))
# gritty high partial, exponential keygen decay; crisp transient
lead*= (0.92*np.exp(-np.arange(N)/(SR*0.34))+0.08)
lead[:35]*=np.linspace(0,1,35)
write('lead',lead*0.72)

# Secondary arpeggio: nasal pulse and triangle, faster decay
N=2400; n=np.arange(N); ph=2*np.pi*n/N
arp=0.58*pulse(ph,.25)+0.22*saw(ph*2)+0.20*np.sin(ph*5)
arp*=0.96*np.exp(-n/(SR*0.17))
arp[:12]*=np.linspace(0,1,12)
write('arp',arp*0.58)

# Bass: rounded saw/sub, punchy but with enough body
N=4200; n=np.arange(N); ph=2*np.pi*n/N
bass=0.52*saw(ph)+0.30*np.sin(ph)+0.18*np.sin(ph*0.5)
bass*=0.98*np.exp(-n/(SR*0.30))
bass[:18]*=np.linspace(0,1,18)
write('bass',bass*0.78)

# Pad/chord: lush detuned saw cloud, loopable single-cycle-ish texture; no decay, slight motion
N=2048; n=np.arange(N); ph=2*np.pi*n/N
pad=0.28*saw(ph)+0.24*saw(ph*1.007+0.4)+0.20*saw(ph*0.993+1.7)+0.16*np.sin(ph*2)+0.12*np.sin(ph*3.01)
# gentle window only at loop seam and full steady state
pad*=0.72
write('pad',pad)

# Kick: descending sine + click, one-shot
N=1300; n=np.arange(N); tt=n/SR
freq=155*np.exp(-n/(SR*0.032))+46
phase=2*np.pi*np.cumsum(freq)/SR
kick=(0.88*np.sin(phase)+0.17*np.sin(2*phase))*np.exp(-n/(SR*0.115))
kick[:9]+=0.22*rng.normal(size=9)*np.linspace(1,0,9)
write('kick',kick*0.82)

# Snare/clap: filtered-ish noise + tonal snap
N=1500; n=np.arange(N); tt=n/SR
noise=rng.normal(0,1,N)
# simple high-pass-ish difference, plus short tone
hp=np.concatenate([[0],np.diff(noise)])
sn=(0.77*hp/np.max(np.abs(hp))+0.23*np.sin(2*np.pi*(185-55*n/N)*tt))*np.exp(-n/(SR*0.105))
sn[:12]*=np.linspace(0,1,12)
write('snare',sn*0.54)

# Closed hat, metallic-ish high partial noise
N=650; n=np.arange(N)
noise=rng.normal(0,1,N)
metal=sum(np.sin(2*np.pi*f*n/SR+ph) for f,ph in [(6200,.2),(7330,1.4),(8110,2.1),(9170,.7)])
hat=(0.60*noise+0.40*metal/4)*np.exp(-n/(SR*0.038))
hat[:3]*=np.linspace(0,1,3)
write('hat',hat*0.36)

# Open hat / crash-ish, longer metallic wash
N=2600; n=np.arange(N); noise=rng.normal(0,1,N)
metal=sum(np.sin(2*np.pi*f*n/SR+ph) for f,ph in [(4800,.2),(6210,1.2),(7530,2.4),(8890,.3)])
openhat=(0.62*noise+0.38*metal/4)*np.exp(-n/(SR*0.22))
write('openhat',openhat*0.30)

import numpy as np, wave, os
SR=8363
C4=261.625565
os.makedirs('/workspace/src/samples', exist_ok=True)
rng=np.random.default_rng(77123)

def write(name, x):
    x=np.asarray(x,dtype=np.float64)
    x=np.clip(x,-1,1)
    y=(x*32767).astype('<i2')
    with wave.open('/workspace/src/samples/'+name+'.wav','wb') as w:
        w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR); w.writeframes(y.tobytes())

def saw(ph): return 2*((ph/(2*np.pi))%1)-1
def pulse(ph,duty=.34): return np.where(((ph/(2*np.pi))%1)<duty,1.,-1.)

# lead: bright square/saw voice, root tuned to C-4, one-shot with a musical tail
N=5200; n=np.arange(N); t=n/SR; ph=2*np.pi*C4*t
lead=.62*pulse(ph,.43)+.20*saw(ph*2+.17)+.11*np.sin(ph*3.01)+.07*np.sin(ph*5.02)
lead*=.86*np.exp(-t/.31)+.14*np.exp(-t/.9)
lead[:24]*=np.linspace(0,1,24)
write('lead',lead*.70)

# arp voice: narrower, glassy pulse, quick decay
N=3300; n=np.arange(N); t=n/SR; ph=2*np.pi*C4*t
arp=.57*pulse(ph,.245)+.23*saw(ph*2+.31)+.14*np.sin(ph*4.01)+.06*np.sin(ph*7.02)
arp*=.95*np.exp(-t/.16)+.05*np.exp(-t/.50)
arp[:14]*=np.linspace(0,1,14)
write('arp',arp*.56)

# bass voice: round saw plus sub, long enough for low notes to ring into cuts
N=6500; n=np.arange(N); t=n/SR; ph=2*np.pi*C4*t
bass=.47*saw(ph)+.24*np.sin(ph)+.16*np.sin(ph*.5)+.09*saw(ph*2+.1)
bass*=.93*np.exp(-t/.62)+.07*np.exp(-t/1.8)
bass[:22]*=np.linspace(0,1,22)
write('bass',bass*.78)

# sustained pad: short attack followed by a precisely seamless 16-cycle loop
attack=520; L=512; N=attack+L*4
n=np.arange(N); ph=np.zeros(N)
# loop waveform is exactly 16 cycles in L samples; harmonics make the tone broad while seam is exact
for i in range(N):
    q=(i-attack)%L
    p=2*np.pi*(16*q/L)
    ph[i]=.34*saw(p)+.22*saw(2*p+.11)+.16*saw(3*p+.37)+.13*np.sin(4*p)+.09*np.sin(5*p+.2)+.06*np.sin(7*p)
# Attack fades into the loop waveform; retain constant sustain after it
pad=ph.copy()
pad[:attack]=ph[attack]*0 # placeholder reset below
for i in range(attack):
    q=i
    p=2*np.pi*(16*q/L)
    base=.34*saw(p)+.22*saw(2*p+.11)+.16*saw(3*p+.37)+.13*np.sin(4*p)+.09*np.sin(5*p+.2)+.06*np.sin(7*p)
    pad[i]=base*(i/attack)**0.65
# exact loop section starts at attack and repeats

write('pad',pad)

N=1500; n=np.arange(N); t=n/SR
